_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Stars/forks/language come live from the API on every run. The description here overrides the repo's GitHub description - two of these repos have none set, so go add real one-line descriptions on GitHub too and then you can delete those overrides.

projects.description: Explainable resume screening and candidate ranking. FastAPI + React, with scores you can actually trace back to why a candidate placed where they did.
A personal engineering dashboard: LeetCode and GitHub tracking, an AI coach, and a live job feed, all in one place.

projects.name: AI Knowledge Platform
projects.description: Turns scattered industrial documentation into a searchable knowledge base you can ask questions of in plain language.
A from-scratch recommendation engine - collaborative filtering and content-based ranking on real rating data.
